title: Australia perils
text:
Australia perils

The following table lists the perils and peril codes that 
Touchstone
 supports for Australia.

| Import peril code | Peril |
| --- | --- |
| PAL | All licensed perils |
| PWB | Bushfire (Australia Bushfire Model). Use PWB instead of the older PEF code that groups together PFF and PWB. |
| PES | Earthquake shake only |
| PPH | Precipitation flood |
| PSH | Hurricane storm surge |
| PWH | Tropical cyclone only |
| PWT | Severe Thunderstorm |

rows: Bushfire (Australia Bushfire Model). Use PWB instead of the older PEF code that groups together PFF and PWB.
